# Media Minds AI Group — Full-Stack AI / Web3 / GEO Agency

> Full-stack agency engineering AI systems, SaaS platforms, autonomous agents, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) infrastructure, and national-scale media campaigns. We build proprietary platforms — we don't just advise. A division of The QuantumX Project.

Media Minds AI Group is the agency that designed, developed, and shipped four proprietary AI-trust platforms (VERA Registry, V-Verify, VeraGraph, FeedSync AI) on top of the AIBlackBox™ engine. We work with brands navigating the shift from traditional search to AI-driven discovery — building the GEO and AEO infrastructure that makes brands cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, and DeepSeek.

## What we do

- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)** — strategy, audits, and infrastructure to get brands cited by AI models
- **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)** — verified-evidence ground truth for AI assistants and zero-click answers
- **AI Systems & Custom Platforms** — autonomous agents, multi-model integrations, sentiment engines, intelligence pipelines
- **Web3 & Blockchain** — smart contracts, on-chain verification, QUBIT Blockchain® anchoring, Polygon deployment
- **National Campaigns & Distribution** — social video, content strategy, ESPN/CBS/ABC/NBC partnerships, performance optimization
- **Brand Strategy** — positioning, market intelligence, competitive analysis, go-to-market plans

## The GEO + AEO + verification stack

GEO optimizes what brands say to AI engines. VERA anchors what's true. The combination is what gets brands consistently, accurately, and verifiably cited.

| Layer | Purpose | Product |
|---|---|---|
| **Verification** | Cryptographically anchored truth | VERA Registry |
| **Identity** | Domain + content authentication | V-Verify |
| **Brand monitoring** | What AI says about you, across platforms | VeraGraph |
| **Distribution** | Push verified signals to where AI looks | FeedSync AI |
| **Engine** | Multi-platform AI query + verification core | AIBlackBox™ |

## Proprietary platforms (the AITP family)

Built by us, powered by AIBlackBox™. These are not advisory engagements — these are our shipped, operating products that prove the methodology works:

- [VERA Registry](https://veraregistry.web.app): The world's first public registry of what AI says about brands, public figures, products, and entities
- [V-Verify](https://vverify.ai): Cryptographic content authentication for the AI internet
- [VeraGraph](https://veragraph.ai): Brand AI verification — claim profiles, correct AI misinformation
- [FeedSync AI](https://feedsyncai.com): Distribute trusted authority signals to AI models
- [QXAI Agent](https://qxaiagent.com): Decentralized AI operating layer for trusted intelligence
